description: TU Delft provides bathymetry-scanner observations from an induced submerged slope failure. A suction dredger undercut the slope toe during flowslide monitoring at Site-C. The native description connects the experiment to Chapter 6.5 of the thesis Sand slope failures: experimental and numerical advances. Coverage: The test-site location is unstated.; 21/8/2019. Format: bin. Access: public native descriptive metadata. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. Current file access and cost remain unknown. Caveats: Point spacing, bathymetry units, coordinate datum and scanner accuracy are unstated. The source-defined parent collection concerns breaching flowslides during mining activities. Simulation use is interpreted as mining slope-hazard and geotechnical calibration evidence; no independent model validation is asserted. Related resources in the native collection have separate identities.
